complaint_text: Pump alarmed OCCLUSION three times during a chemotherapy infusion even though the line was visibly clear. We swapped to a backup pump. No patient harm but therapy was delayed roughly 40 minutes. This is the second time on this unit.

My meter read 142 and then 61 two minutes later on the same finger. I dosed insulin off the first reading and ended up in the emergency room overnight with severe hypoglycemia. I want someone to call me.
Received carton of 12 staplers. Four sterile barrier pouches had a broken seal along the top edge. Product not used. Photos available on request. Please advise on return.
Our monthly order was supposed to arrive on the 28th and only showed up today. We had to reschedule two patient fittings. Not a product problem, just delivery.
Water keeps leaking out of the humidifier chamber onto my nightstand. Machine still runs. I have tried reseating the chamber twice.
The phone app stopped syncing with my oximeter after the last update. The device works, I just can't see history in the app.

Patient started Cardiozan two weeks ago, developed facial swelling and diffuse rash, presented to urgent care and was treated with steroids. Drug discontinued. Reporting as suspected adverse reaction.
Carton labeling and IFU are printed in German only. Product is destined for Sweden and Finland. Local requirement is Swedish and Finnish. We have quarantined 60 units.
We were charged twice for invoice 88231 on the same card. Please refund the duplicate.
The dose dial sticks and sometimes clicks past the number I want. I think I have been getting less insulin than I set. My sugars have been running high all week.
Pump screen went completely blank mid-infusion in the ICU. We restarted and it came back but we cannot trust it. Unit is out of service pending your response.
Cuff readings are about 20 points higher than at my doctor's office every single time. Doctor says the device may be off.
Stapler misfired during a bowel resection, staple line incomplete. Surgeon oversewed the anastomosis. Procedure extended by about 25 minutes. Patient stable but this could have been serious.
Cream caused burning and blistering where I applied it. I stopped after two days. Skin is still red a week later. Saw my GP who prescribed something else.
I cannot work out how to change the ramp setting from the menu. The booklet talks about a clinician mode but does not say how to get out of it. Nobody at the supply company could tell me either.
Six oximeters will not pair with the clinic tablet since the firmware push last Tuesday. They pair fine with a personal phone. Something in the update has broken the managed device path.
Pallet arrived with the outer shrink wrap torn and two cartons crushed at the corner. Contents of the crushed cartons look intact but we are not willing to release them without your sign-off.
Four pens in this lot have a visible gap between the cap and the barrel and the tamper ring is already broken on two of them. Sterility of the needle assembly cannot be assured. Lot held.

The compressor has got much louder over the last month and a treatment that used to take eight minutes now takes fifteen. My chest feels the same afterwards so I think it is still working, just slowly.
I received a package addressed to me but the delivery note inside has another patient's full name, address and their prescription details on it. I have not opened the product. Who do I send this to?

Meter is reading consistently 30 to 40 points below our laboratory reference on the same sample. Two patients have been advised to eat on the back of low readings that were not real. No harm so far but we have withdrawn all four units from clinic.
The cuff strap has frayed along the edge after about three weeks of daily use. It still fastens but it looks like it will not last much longer.
We were quoted a unit price of 42 and the invoice has come through at 61 with no explanation. Order reference 55820. Please clarify before we pay.
The carton states 40mg but the blister foil is printed 20mg. Same lot, all cartons checked show the same mismatch. We have not released any of this to pharmacy. 240 packs affected.

Pump delivered what we believe was a free-flow bolus when the set was removed without the clamp engaged. Neonate became fluid overloaded and needed transfer to a higher level of care. We have the set and the pump preserved for you.
Battery indicator in the app never moves off 100 percent even when the device is clearly nearly flat. Minor annoyance rather than a real problem.

I was never shown how to prime this properly. I have been injecting without priming for about two weeks because the pharmacy did not mention it. My readings have been off and I only found out from a video online.
Two of the four boxes on this week's delivery are missing. The carrier note says four were signed for. We are short and need the balance shipped urgently.

Two patients on the same lot have shown a marked rise in creatinine within a fortnight of starting. Both have been taken off the drug and one required admission for rehydration. We are flagging this as a possible lot-specific issue.

Post-operative infection in a patient where this device was used. On review the pouch had a compromised seal that was not spotted at the time. Patient returned to theatre for washout and is on IV antibiotics. Device and packaging retained.
Unit shut itself off twice in the night without any alarm. I woke up gasping both times. I have been too frightened to use it since and I have not slept properly in four days.
Nothing is wrong. I just wanted to say the new carrying case is a big improvement over the old one and the handle is much easier for me with arthritis.
Twelve meters from this lot fail their own start-up self-test and display Err 4. They are unusable out of the box. Remainder of the lot held pending your instruction.
We cancelled order 56102 within the hour and it has still been charged in full. Please refund. This is the second time this has happened this quarter.
The reporting portal times out whenever we try to export a full seven day recording. Shorter exports work. We have tried three browsers and two networks. This is holding up several reports.
The outer carton is missing the storage temperature statement entirely. The leaflet has it but the carton does not, which does not meet local requirements. 150 units held.

Pen delivered what the patient describes as a full cartridge in one press. He was found unresponsive by his wife and taken in by ambulance with a glucose of 1.9. He is stable now. The pen is with us and has not been touched since.

Shipment sat at the depot for six days and arrived with the cold chain indicator tripped. We have not accepted it into stock. Need replacement and a view on whether anything already delivered this month is affected.

I developed a spreading rash on my chest and neck two days after starting the cream, nowhere near where I applied it. My GP thinks it is a reaction to the product and has referred me to dermatology. Still visible three weeks on.
Air-in-line alarm failed to trigger with a visible column of air in the set. We caught it by eye. If nobody had been standing there that would have gone into the patient. Unit withdrawn immediately.
